# Build

> Guides for renting GPU and CPU compute on Fluence Cloud: the Fluence Console at console.fluence.ai, the Fluence API at api.fluence.dev, accounts, balance, and billing.

If you are new to Fluence Cloud, start with the [Overview](https://fluence.dev/docs/build/overview.md). It lists what you can rent and the ways to work with Fluence Cloud. The CPU Cloud and GPU Cloud sections each start with a concepts page about resources, statuses, and billing. The Cloud Agents section covers coding agents that run on their own machines in your account, starting with [Cloud agents concepts](https://fluence.dev/docs/build/cloud_agents/overview.md). For code, start with the [API overview](https://fluence.dev/docs/build/api/overview.md). New integrations use the Public v3 API.

AI agents can fund an account over HTTP (x402 on Base or MPP on Tempo) and sign in without a human. See [Pay with x402 or MPP](https://fluence.dev/docs/build/api/x402.md). To connect an MCP client, see [Connect an AI client through MCP](https://fluence.dev/docs/build_with_ai/mcp.md).
